bestBets.overview: No rain leading in nor on the day - if the BOM is a good guide, hence the track should be perfect. Rail is out 9.5m  Kick things off with a 1650m Maiden Plate. No's 2,3,6 look to be the pace. Not sure many of these are punt-worthy but I did like the run of HIGHLAND KITTY when resuming, albeit making it four straight 2nds for the mare. Down on 55 after the claim. Should be the one to beat. URBAN PRINCESS will appreciate dropping back 100m. Could be the danger.

raceTips.comment: Midweek racing at Doomben under sunny skies on an ideal surface. We open the day with mile maiden where I'm leaning to Highland Kitty however I wouldn't be launching into a short price as she may need one more. She did hit the line well fresh & this is no harder. Kalamia King & Urban Princess look close off their recent efforts albeit in provincial grade.

bestBets.overview: 1350m QTIS 3yo Maiden Plate. Three of the nine are on debut, they have each have had at least two public trials. In what looks to be a no pace race 'on 'paper' could be no's 2 and 5 providing that 'pace'. RAGING RAIDER looks awfully hard to beat. Ran on well for 3rd when fresh then 2nd-up attempted 1400m at Eagle Farm at Saturday level, for a maiden was not at all disgraced. DRAGON MAGIC strips fitter, TED LASSO open to natural improvement.

raceTips.comment: Not a great deal of depth to this 1350m maiden. Raging Raider ran well first up before heading to a stronger Saturday race which turned into a mad sprint home which just didn't suit. Down in class, carries the same weight & leading jockey Ben Thompson jumps aboard. Ted Lasso was ok on debut at the Gold Coast, fitter & wiser for this tougher task.

bestBets.overview: 1350m Maiden Hcp. No's 2,4,6 look to be the frontrunners in transit. MOSCOW MULE sure is an odd name for what appears to be a talented horse. Either suggesting it's old man is a donkey? or this is an illegal drug runner? Bottom-line, was one helluva unlucky racehorse here last start, held-up for the better part of 300m.  6th once clear, sure found the line. The 3rd on debut is a solid form line too. Of course, from the 1350m the alley is no concern at all. ST ANDREWS had no favours in that same race and is capable of once again running a place. HAD IT ALL comes a via a quicker heat held that day and maps to give them all something to catch. EDGE OF INFINITY finished ahead of Moscow Mule at Eagle Farm two starts back, albeit the latter was on debut, this was having its 3rd run for the prep.

raceTips.comment: Moscow Mule was very good on debut sitting back & wide before closing off well in the straight. That run saw him sent out an odds-on favourite next start when having no luck gaining a run whatsoever until way too late, strong to the line unfortunately the bird had well & truly flown. Same trip, wide gate & a 9.5m rail suggests a possible 'train wreck' however I can't tip against him. Had It All looks close & will roll forward, can the Mule run her down?

bestBets.overview: 1650m BM65. No's 1,2,3 most likely to set the pace, 6 and/or 8 could be next in line.  FLYING BAT is five weeks between starts but I am not doubting Allan Chau one bit, the two recent wins were off four week gaps. CARNEGIE HILL has to make up almost five lengths to turn the tables from their recent Beaudesert clash. ROSSO LEVANTO won well fresh, is the light-raced one on the up and this map would appear to suit it down to the ground. EMPIRE OF ART resumes, went close without much luck when last seen fresh and that was 1666m. It is one of three Waller saddles up here. WOUNDER is another of his trio, is up from NSW and should have finished closer at Warwick Farm last start. Is start eight for the campaign, has Waller left this obvious and wise move too late for the time being?

raceTips.comment: Rosso Levanto arrived late to score first up at Eagle Farm recently. Fitter she steps up to the mile plus today which will suit & drawn the rails gate she can park close which will be advantageous with the 9.5m rail. Gagnante Enchere hit the line well here last start 1350m, I'm not convinced about her running a strong mile however she has no weight & will get every chance to do so.

bestBets.overview: 2060m C3. No's 3,6,7,10,12,13 should make up the front half in transit. AMPLIFY caught the eye when 4th home at Eagle Farm last start. If they can run on around here today this should be hard to hold out. DIAMOND SHOW was ahead of it there and meets it better here but regardless the additional 260m should see those tables turned. To my eye 1800m could be as far as the mare wants. Clearly C & C Munce disagree. Two heads better than one! SARAH'S SONNETS had plenty in hand latest. 4th run in here, just 7th career start,  remains open to natural improvement. O'CALDINO was a victim of the Plate Weights last start. Meets the toppy 8 kgs better, Diamond Show 4 better. If this goes up overs, London to a brick  it will be set upon early.

raceTips.comment: Sarah's Sonnets was highly impressive winning at the Gold Coast last start & although this is harder I'd have her on top had the race been further. Unfortunately she's back in trip which just doesn't suit imo. Amplify & Diamond Show are the two on form, interestingly though neither have been to this longer distance, the former comes out of the race this morning. Diamond Show it is then without getting carried away.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C1. Not an easy map to predict. No's 1,2,4,5,6,8,9,10 all candidates to seek a forward berth. The wider drawn from them could be in for a tough time of it. CITY GOLD FIELD was off the map when 1st-up for the 'new yard'. Barely resembled its former self. Natural pace on display. Gate two awaits as does a claim. And Billy Healey is happy to send out just the one in this field, on many occasions nowadays he can have multiple runners clash to increase his chances. Think he's justifiably confident, think this takes beating. YES DONALD YES resumes and maps well for Cejay Graham. If they can run on, Don should. LA PROFECIA will appreciate dropping back to 1200m and, as is the case with 4, Gollan is content to send just one around, which nowadays is akin to Hailey's Comet. Aka a free tip. ZALIQUE well and truly in discussions off an easy win 1st-up at Grafton.

raceTips.comment: Found this a very tough race. With the 9.5m rail this track should play very leaderish which plays into the hands of La Profecia, the drop back to 1200m suits, I'll lean his way. Swift Duke loomed to win at the Gold Coast peaking on his finish, fitter however this is a tougher task, he gets a good run in the race though. The lightly raced Zalique another stepping up in grade however has upside & comes into this off a last start win during the Grafton carnival.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C1. Five resume, many a key runner amongst them. Multiple runners in the field. Vandyke and C & C Munce both good for two and Gollan has settled upon three. For the record no's 4,11,12,14,15 often settle forward. VANESSI resumes. To date has run well fresh without winning, all attempts were in Sydney. CAPITAL CHORD resumes, impressed only prior fresh. DON'T DOUBT MISSY resumes. She had excuses only prior fresh. MYTHOLOGY resumes. First start  for Gollan hence wary. Sure looks a race to follow money or keep right out. I'll be doing the latter.

raceTips.comment: Stein back in grade from an ok gate shouldn't be too far away in the run here, consistent without winning can figure once again. I will be guided by the market leads re Capital Chord, very impressive winning on debut she was thrown straight into a Saturday grade race & didn't measure up. Immediately spelled she's had two lead up trials, the latter was the better of the two & it was nothing to get excited about. The draw is a good one though & any repeat of the debut has her going close to winning, should she not be supported in betting I will be avoiding. Vanessi maps well, Strada Varenna & Mythology trialled well. Very open race.

bestBets.overview: 1350m C3. No's 2,5,6,13,14 looks to be where the pace resides. SHELSTEIN came in for good support but was well and truly waving the white flag 100m from home. File this under 'where there's smoke there's fire' aka give another chance. TOO HOT TO TORQUE twice raced out of its grade, wasn't disgraced in the latter. ARTFUL PERSUASION was heavily backed 2nd-up, found two better. Was a time when a John Smerdon plunge was better than bank interest. Are those days gone? WARNA has to be a hope. Saved from an awfully suitable race at Rockhampton at an awfully good price for this, unless you think Kendrick is no judge (and/or whoever advised him "not there, here!") this is a free tip. LAND BANK strips fitter, is one for one 2nd up, draws gate two for B Thompson. FLAXLANDS is flying. The alley gives Jake Bayliss every possible to emulate R Maloney from go to whoa and bring it home.

raceTips.comment: Happy to stick with the in-form mare Flaxlands in this closing race. She settled close enough last start & can do so again, looks to have plenty of upside & is in the right yard. Cambridge Bay will race up on speed, hard not to from the rails gate & has been kept fresh off the first up win. Land Bank maps well for Ben Thompson & strips fitter second-up.
